title: GridShell /terminal client→server message
description: Every message a client sends on the /terminal WebSocket. Discriminated by `type`. See README.md in this directory for what this schema does NOT cover (reattach/buffer-replay, evict-on-attach, idle-kill timing - behavioral guarantees, not message shapes).

oneOf.title: resize
oneOf.description: Requests a terminal size. Sent once before the very first message on a fresh connection (triggers the initial shell spawn) and again on every subsequent resize. The server clamps cols/rows to a minimum of 1 rather than rejecting a smaller/invalid value.

oneOf.title: input
oneOf.description: Raw keystrokes/bytes to write to the shell's stdin, exactly as the terminal emulator (e.g. xterm.js) produced them - no line-based framing.

oneOf.title: terminate
oneOf.description: Kills the shell immediately and deletes the session, bypassing the idle-grace timer entirely. Distinct from simply closing the WebSocket, which only starts the idle-grace countdown (see README.md).
